title: EMPTY HANDS IN
ADVENT WAITING
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: peaceful winter river sunrise mountain valley
golden sunlit valley early morning light
warm sunlight on quiet rustic wooden table
golden light breaking over peaceful hills morning

scenes.a: Your hands feel empty in this Advent waiting.
As we look for Christ’s light to break into the dark, hear Mary's song from Luke:
He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
Father, we bring our genuine hunger to Your table today, setting aside self-reliance for Your daily grace.
Provide for our quiet needs, open the right doors, and satisfy our souls with Your good gifts.
scenes.sub: SATISFY OUR SOULS WITH GOOD GIFTS

scenes.a: Teach us that true abundance comes only from Your hand, not our own storehouses.
Amen. Be filled, even when your hands feel empty in this Advent waiting.
